text:
jamal: FYI trivy job on prod-scan-2 is failing with KMS decrypt errors since last deploy. started ~09:12
olivia: got the logs? saw a couple of 403s earlier, maybe RBAC token rotation hit the scanner role
jamal: here's the tail of the error log i pulled from the runner:
```
ERROR: failed to decrypt key: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/scan-worker is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key 1111-2222
	status code: 403, request id: b3f2...
```
srini: looks like we rotated the scanner role policy yesterday to drop kms:Decrypt for cross-account - intended to tighten perms but broke trivy
maya: we did that as a precaution for dedicated-capacity access. can we add an explicit allow for the scan role only? @olivia any objections
olivia: no objections to scoped kms:Decrypt. prefer resource-scoped allow to avoid broad perms. also we should add an audit condition (tag "scanner=true")
jamal: aside: Snyk is reporting a bunch of vulnerable transitive deps but GHAS shows lower severity for the same CVEs — our triage queue is confusing people
srini: Snyk maps via CVSS, GHAS sometimes annotates "low"/"medium" differently. We should normalise severities before creating incidents so paging works
maya: +1. Also the suppression rules got out of sync after the config migration; GHAS filters are ignoring a subset of suppressions and the scanner-orch treats them as new findings
security-bot: [alert] suppression-audit: 47 suppressions with no matching GHAS rule; last-scan: 2023-12-04T09:00:00Z
olivia: plan: 1) revert the RBAC change for scan-worker (short-term) 2) run full suppression-audit and export mismatches 3) add severity-normalization job in scanner-orch and update triage docs
jamal: can we fast-track the revert? CI gating scans are blocking release candidates
ci-bot: rollback job queued: `infra/rollback-rbac` started by jamal via /run, job id: 78a2f
srini: I'll open PR to re-add kms:Decrypt scoped to `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/1111-2222` and post diffs here. will include condition: `aws:RequestTag/scanner`
maya: also propose adding an audit-log alert for KMS DecryptDenied events with tag `scanner=true` so future rotations surface immediately
olivia: agree. runbook addition: if KMS 403 appears, check role policy diff, revert via canary, and notify security-oncall. include steps to re-run suppression sync job
jamal: for patch prioritization: mark libs with runtime==prod and severity>=high as P0 for next sprint. we should also add a test harness for the top 10 deps to smoke-test after upgrades
olivia: filing GH issue to track severity-normalization RFC and a follow-up for suppression cleanup
jamal: thanks all — syncing with platform team in 30m to coordinate the revert and suppression sync
olivia: ping if the rollback job fails, we'll escalate to infra
jamal: end
